$schema_note: ADR-P041 sandbox serving wire-format golden vectors. Vendored BYTE-IDENTICAL into the vsify-module-sandbox image repo. A test on each side (this repo: tests/test_wire_framing.py; the image repo: tests/test_wire_conformance.py) asserts its own codec produces/consumes these exact bytes. Header layout: MAGIC(4)=b'VSB1' | VERSION(u16 BE) | TYPE(u8) | FLAGS(u8, bit0=truncated) | LENGTH(u32 BE) | payload.

vectors.name: ready_empty
vectors.description: The READY handshake frame — always empty payload, sent once by the entrypoint after its module import succeeds.

vectors.name: response_truncated
vectors.description: A RESPONSE frame with the truncated flag set BY THE PRODUCER (never invented by a reader).

vectors.name: error_generic
vectors.description: An ERROR frame — signals the sandbox itself detected a fault; the host treats it as a died handle.

vectors.name: request_empty
vectors.description: A REQUEST frame with an empty payload — must round-trip cleanly, not be confused with a malformed frame.
